publicProfile.headline: Radiologist turned detail-obsessed coffee equipment expert and educator
publicProfile.summary: Attending radiologist with 10+ years of chest imaging and AI tool adoption experience. Outside medicine, runs a 12k-reader espresso equipment blog, restores machines, speaks publicly and built a 60-member café community. Open to roles that combine technical depth, teaching and community.

Teaches imaging interpretation to 20 residents per year
